name: xoga754-02-neovest-filename-cfs-dev
description: Neovest pipeline output file name: hardcode the BU prefix CFS instead of the BU chosen on screen. Only workflowConfig.output.options.fileNamePattern of the Neovest PIPELINE CONFIG row (dev tenant) changes.

steps.where: tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND template_name = 'Neovest' AND code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND rule_data->'workflowConfig'->'output'->'options'->>'fileNamePattern' = '${neovestBuName}_Neovest_TR_Dump_${neovestFileDate}.xlsx'
